title: Mahmood scraps settlement plans for migrant care workers
description: The home secretary laid out a revised proposal for changing when migrants can claim permanent residency.

title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
description: The temperature of freezers in several shops across Europe reportedly rose to as high as 50C.

title: Thousands of European troops to rehearse Ukraine deployment in event of peace
description: Western officials stress that any force sent to Ukraine would not take part in any offensive operations.

title: PM plans debt re-set for Commonwealth nations as slavery apology talks begin
description: The move comes as the prime minister begins talks about the UK issuing a formal apology for the slave trade in the next year.

title: Jewellery sold as sterling silver on Amazon and Temu found to contain toxic chemicals
description: An investigation by Watchdog analysed 25 items bought from Amazon, Etsy, Temu, eBay and OnBuy.

title: Plane may have broken apart ahead of deadly Florida jet crash, say investigators
description: The National Transportation Safety Board also believes weather could have been a factor in the crash, but warns it is too early to determine the cause.

title: What Florida jet audio and flight data tells us about its final moments
description: A private jet crashed in Florida on Sunday, killing all nine people on board, according to US authorities.

title: Russian bombing kills 26 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
description: Officials say at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit a southern Ukrainian village in what the president called an "utterly horrific" attack.

title: North Korea denies being behind record $6.3bn Binance hack
description: US government agencies and cyber analysts have blamed Pyongyang for the record-breaking heist.
